scenario: Each of the five log levels (`debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error` and `critical`, LGRA.10.1.1) is accepted on a `log` action, and the rule carrying all five compiles. PINS ONLY THAT IT COMPILES: `compile_ok` does not observe the lowering.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    log debug "a"
    log info "b"
    log warning "c"
    log error "d"
    log critical "e"
